event: Harbor Finch Pantry LLC submitted its vendor profile and signed W-9 for Northstar onboarding.
Harbor Finch accepted Northstar Merchandise Terms version NRM-MT-2026.2.
After core identity review, VendorLink assigned NVID-10482 Conditional status pending activation gates.
The vendor uploaded certificate MCS-884201; the certificate's policy expiration date was August 31, 2026, so it was already expired when submitted.
Accounts Payable completed tax and payment validation.
The VendorLink connectivity test passed using noncommercial test payloads.
Required R2 facility information was accepted with no additional facility gate or Q&R block.
Merchandising authorized SKU PG-48217 for a September 21 set.
Procurement completed working draft PO 78431 but did not transmit it through VendorLink or an approved connection.
Merchandising asked whether Harbor Finch could be activated by Friday because of the upcoming promotion.
VendorLink still showed Conditional status; every listed activation gate except CURRENT_COI passed, and no exception was recorded.
